Scenario fixture: tab-name-present (role="tab" must have an accessible name)

Each target element has a stable id of the form tab_case_NN. role="tab" is name-from-content: aria-label > aria-labelledby > title > content.

A. Baseline: mechanism priority order (eligible)

01 — FAIL: role=tab, no name at all, no content
02 — PASS: role=tab, visible text content
Apple
03 — PASS: role=tab, aria-label
04 — PASS: role=tab, aria-labelledby
Cherry
05 — PASS: role=tab, title
06 — FAIL: role=tab, content is aria-hidden (does not count)
Elderberry
07 — FAIL: role=tab, content is [hidden] (does not count)
Fig
08 — FAIL: role=tab, whitespace-only content
09 — FAIL: role=tab, aria-label empty string, no fallback content

B. Visible but excluded from AT (ineligible)

10 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden="true", not focusable, missing name
11 — EXCEPTION: aria-hidden="true" but focusable => eligible, missing name => FAIL

C. Hidden by HTML/CSS (ineligible)

12 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: hidden attribute
13 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: display:none
14 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden
15 — EXCEPTION: visibility:hidden ancestor overridden by descendant visibility:visible => eligible, missing name => FAIL

D. Inertness (ineligible)

16 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert on element itself
17 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor

End of fixture.
